title: Discussion session on Particle ID
description:
Today's session is the last of those dedicated to particle identification (PID) and will feature a panel discussion by members of the STAR and PHENIX collaborations from RHIC and LHCb, CMS, and ATLAS collaborations from LHC. Previous sessions have featured talks on PID at STAR, CMS, and LHCb. Today's session will begin with a 25 minute presentation on PID at PHENIX. This will be followed by a questions and discussion session with the full panel.

Panel Members: Roli Esha, Chitrasen Jena, Wei Li, Yanxi Zhang
Moderator: Subhasish Chattopadhyay
